learning_outcomes.text: After completing the lectures TM I and TM II, students can calculate and evaluate 3D stress and strain states within the framework of linear elasticity and thermoelasticity.
Apply the principle of virtual displacements of analytical mechanics.
Apply energy methods and evaluate approximate solutions.
Evaluate the stability of equilibrium positions.
In TM III and TM IV, students learn to investigate kinematics for the movements of points and systems.
Derive equations of motion based on Newton-Euler's axioms.
Apply analytical methods, where energy expressions form the starting point, and which can be applied particularly efficiently and formally.
Determine and analyze movements and forces caused by movements for mechanical engineering systems.

syllabus_topics: Internal forces in rods and beams
Center of gravity and center of mass
Work, energy, principle of virtual displacements
Kinematics: Cartesian, cylindrical, and natural coordinates
Kinetics of a mass point: Newton's fundamental law
Work, kinetic energy, potential and energy
Systems of mass points: Center of mass theorem
Planar motion of rigid bodies: Kinematics for translation, rotation, and general motion
Kinetics, angular momentum theorem, work theorem and energy theorem for rotation about a fixed axis
Determination of mass moments of inertia about an axis through the center of mass
Momentum and angular momentum theorem for any planar motion
d'Alembert's principle for planar rigid body motion
Momentum and angular momentum theorem in integral form
Kinematics of a rigid body in spatial motion
Angular velocity of a rigid body using Euler angles
Kinetic energy of a rigid body
Lagrangian equations of the first and second kind
Free and forced vibrations of single-degree-of-freedom systems
assessment_rules: The module grade is calculated from the ECTS-weighted average of the included graded partial achievements. Separate preliminary achievements must be completed for admission to the individual exams. Preliminary achievement for Technical Mechanics I: study achievement Exercises for Technical Mechanics I. Preliminary achievement for Technical Mechanics II: study achievement Exercises for Technical Mechanics II. Preliminary achievement for TM III, IV: study achievement Exercises for Technical Mechanics III and study achievement Exercises for Technical Mechanics IV.
